name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait: the session that should have caught your 20:24 message wasn't running, and I only woke up now. Your request is logged as BH2 (it extends BH1, the stuck 13-day-old bets). I'm starting on it now: finding why the grader gets no final score for old finished games, then fixing it in code so the phone settles them itself from real scores. I can't enter results into your phone's Tracker directly, so the fix has to be a release. I'll message you when it ships.
